roles.name: Competitive analyst
roles.job: Watch our competitors' websites and report each week what changed in their pricing and positioning, with before and after and a link to each change.

roles.name: Customer advisor
roles.job: Read new customer feedback each morning, group it into themes with a representative quote for each, and file feature requests against the ideas they support.

roles.name: PRFAQ writer
roles.job: Turn a feature idea and the evidence behind it into a one-page PRFAQ, working backwards from the customer, with the open questions listed at the end.
